_meta.description: Ground-truth expectations for audit/questions.md. One entry per question TRIPLET (same question in Gujarati/Hindi/English) — expectations are language-independent by design: all three variants must produce the SAME intent, entities, and query type. This is the cross-language consistency check.
_meta.expected_flow: legacy flow label (GREETING/GENERAL/NAVIGATION/SQL) for comparing against the CURRENT pipeline baseline before Phase 1 ships
_meta.expected_entities: canonical Gujarati values as they should resolve AFTER Stage 2 (language-independent). Keys: crop, category, location, equipment, animal, news_type, topic, identifier. 'topic' and 'identifier' are free-text — not catalog-checkable.
_meta.expected_constraints: informative list of constraints the user EXPLICITLY asked for. Anything not listed here must NOT appear in generated SQL (hallucination check).
_meta.review_note: flags where my prefilled label needs the project owner's confirmation
_meta.data_dependent: true = correct answer depends on rows existing in the DB; run validate_expectations.py to check entity presence against the catalog

expectations.summary_en: Ram Ram brother! Is anyone awake or is everyone asleep?
Jai Shree Krishna, how do I start chatting in this?
expectations.review_note: Greeting + real question hybrid — the question part ('how to start chatting') wins per routing rule. Alternative acceptable label: general.

expectations.summary_en: Hey brother, is there anyone to reply in this or is it all just empty?
expectations.review_note: Conversational presence-check — a warm greeting-style reply is correct. Alternative: general.

expectations.summary_en: Sitaram brother, explain to me how this app works.
Will using this app deduct money from my bank, or is it entirely free?
expectations.review_note: Should match the 'is the app free' entry in general_questions.json

expectations.summary_en: I need to call your head office, give me a working phone number.
expectations.review_note: Needs a contact/support entry in general_questions.json — verify one exists with the real number

expectations.summary_en: Who created Krushi Ratn? Government or private company?
expectations.review_note: Verify general_questions.json has a company/ownership entry; if not, honest 'no info' is the correct answer

expectations.summary_en: If fraud occurs, who supports me? Where is your office?
I want to sell my old bull and tractor — where do I go to upload photos?
expectations.review_note: Explicit SELL process → navigation (Buy/Sell listing steps). Entities (ટ્રેક્ટર, સાંઢ) are context, not search keywords.

expectations.summary_en: Where can I watch the video by the export expert? Open that page.
expectations.review_note: DECIDED (owner, 2026-06-12): 'where can I watch X / open that page' → NAVIGATION — guide the user to the videos screen, no DB search. Explicit list requests ('show me videos about X') remain video/SQL.

expectations.summary_en: Where does the video about the new automatic cotton sowing method appear?
expectations.review_note: DECIDED (owner, 2026-06-12): same policy as Q28-30 — 'where does this video appear' → NAVIGATION, guide to videos screen.

expectations.summary_en: I want to buy a new seed drill from the company — which section do I order in?
expectations.review_note: Explicit BUY process ('which section do I visit to place the order') → navigation per agreed rule. If user had asked its price → equipment_kshop/SQL.

expectations.summary_en: Where is the page to fill the government solar pump subsidy form?
expectations.review_note: App may have no subsidy-form feature — honest 'feature not available, schemes appear in news section' is a correct answer. Acceptable alternative: news.

expectations.summary_en: Show me where the village weather forecast and alerts page is.
expectations.review_note: User asks WHERE the page is → navigation. If they asked for the forecast itself → news/SQL. Borderline — confirm.

expectations.summary_en: I want to see listings of buffaloes and cows for sale — where do I click?
expectations.review_note: DECIDED (owner, 2026-06-12): SQL confirmed — the bot fetches the listings from the database.

expectations.summary_en: Highest price for groundnut Magdi in Bhavnagar city yard today?
expectations.review_note: Hindi variant says મૂંગફળી મગડી — must resolve to the same canonical શીંગ મગડી.

expectations.summary_en: Per-maund prices for cotton and black sesame in Gariadhar taluka?
expectations.review_note: MULTI-ITEM: two crops must be searched separately, never concatenated. User said 'taluka' explicitly → taluka-level filter is correct.

expectations.summary_en: Min and max new price of groundnut Kadri in Mahuva yard?
expectations.review_note: VARIETY CASE: શીંગ + કાદરી must resolve together. Validator must confirm શીંગ કાદરી exists in DB — this question may be Claude-invented.

expectations.summary_en: Today's pearl millet price under grains or pulses category near Keshod?
expectations.review_note: Canonical could be બાજરો or બાજરી — validator will tell. Category words are secondary; direct crop match should win.

expectations.summary_en: List cash crops and oilseeds with rates in Visavadar market yard.
expectations.review_note: CATEGORY-SCOPED LIST: no crop keyword — filter via categories, list crops with prices. Two categories = OR, not concatenated.

expectations.summary_en: Which yard in Jamnagar city has the lowest price for white sesame and soybean?
expectations.review_note: MULTI-ITEM + aggregation: lowest price per yard.

expectations.summary_en: In which taluka across Gujarat is cotton (cash crops category) priced above 1500?
expectations.review_note: ગુજરાત is a STATE — must land on states filter, never city/taluka/yard.

expectations.summary_en: Minimum price of groundnut Girnar and ginger in Gariadhar?
expectations.review_note: VARIETY (શીંગ ગીરનાર) + plain crop (આદું) in one query — both must survive extraction.

expectations.summary_en: What is the current company price for the new seeder?
expectations.review_note: 'new' + 'company' → K-Shop, no clarification needed (condition explicit).

expectations.summary_en: Which companies have stock listed under motor starter and battery sprayer categories?
expectations.review_note: Output entity is COMPANIES, filter entity is two kshop categories — must not merge the two categories into one string.

expectations.summary_en: Is there a discounted price on the submersible pump or is it fixed?
expectations.review_note: kshop_products has discount_price column — answer should compare price vs discount_price.

expectations.summary_en: Price of the most expensive item in brush cutter and earth augers categories?
Buying a new branded Jhatka machine — what rate with warranty?
expectations.review_note: Warranty info likely not in DB — answer gives price, honestly omits warranty. Buy-verb present BUT price asked → SQL not navigation (the agreed nuance).

expectations.summary_en: Has any farmer listed a second-hand tractor or trolley? Asking price?
expectations.review_note: MULTI-ITEM, 'second hand' → buy_sell, no clarification (condition explicit).

expectations.summary_en: Any milk-giving Gir cow for sale cheap under the cattle category?
expectations.review_note: ગીર is a breed qualifier inside free-text listing names — category filter = ગાય, breed = secondary LIKE on product rows. Confirm handling.

expectations.summary_en: Is anyone selling a used thresher nearby?
expectations.review_note: 'Nearby' is UNRESOLVABLE (no user location available) — correct behavior: search without location filter, do NOT invent one. Hallucination check.

expectations.summary_en: On what date was the latest ad posted under sheep/goat or horse categories?
expectations.review_note: Two categories, ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT — date is the answer.

expectations.summary_en: Phone number of the owner of listing ID Tractor - 1778741216208?
expectations.expected_behavior: privacy_redirect — the answer must NOT contain any phone number; politely direct the user to the in-app contact-seller flow
expectations.review_note: DECIDED (owner, 2026-06-12): never expose seller phone numbers. The pipeline may look up the listing, but the answer redirects to the in-app contact guide. Enforce via privacy sanitization + answer prompt; verify in baseline and Phase 3.

expectations.summary_en: New Gujarat government circular for produce subsidies in scheme news?
expectations.review_note: DB canonical confirmed: 'સરકાર અને યોજના સમાચાર'. User phrase 'સરકારી યોજના' maps via entity_catalog_manual.json.

expectations.summary_en: Any heavy-rain or cyclone news posted today for Bhavnagar Gariadhar region?
expectations.review_note: MULTI-LOCATION (city + taluka). 'Today' explicitly said → date filter is correct here.

expectations.summary_en: Update in news types about crop insurance forms for Junagadh Visavadar area?
Any weather-department rain forecast news for Keshod taluka this month?
expectations.review_note: User explicitly said 'this month' → date filter correct.

expectations.summary_en: Under which news type will I find Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana updates?
expectations.review_note: Answer = the news_type of matching news rows (reverse lookup: topic → which type).
